Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, when the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was
struck by Driver 2's vehicle, which was following too closely to stop. Driver 2 told me he looked down for a momnet
and did not see the traffic slowing ahead. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and
reported a concussion, with a headache and dizziness, and was evaluated at the scene before being transported by
EMS for further care. Witnesses at the scene, the photographs taken by responding officers, and Driver 2's own
account all agree on how the collision happened. The rear bumper and trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle show damage
that is largely consistent with the impact described. A few older scratches are visible on the lower bumper, but they
may predate this crash and were noted separately. Officers and witnesses confirm that Passenger was in the vehicle
at the time of impact. Whether the reported head injury resulted from this collision has not yet been determined.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
